crossRefs.note: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.
There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything…
He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
translations.bsb: and said, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one of us is missing.
translations.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man
translations.asv: and they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war that are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
